name: Gateway Student Accommodation
description: NSFAS-accredited student accommodation in Doornfontein, Johannesburg, for Wits, UJ and nearby colleges. Fully furnished rooms with free electricity, water and a free campus shuttle.

hero.heading: Student living, sorted.
hero.text: Fully furnished, NSFAS-accredited rooms in Doornfontein, with free electricity, free water and our own shuttle to campus.

perks.title: Free electricity
perks.text: Municipal electricity is included. No prepaid meters, no surprises.

perks.title: Free water
perks.text: Municipal water is included in every room.

perks.title: Free shuttle
perks.text: Our own bus runs Monday to Friday, every hour from 7am to 9pm.

perks.title: Fully furnished
perks.text: Every room comes ready to move into, so you only bring your things.

perks.title: NSFAS accredited
perks.text: Accredited by both UJ and Wits. We also welcome bursary and cash-paying students.

perks.title: Secure
perks.text: Controlled access and security around the clock, so you can focus on your studies.
